drawing: 4-door wardrobe; no dimension lines. Width from parts: 2 sides + 2 partitions (16) + 2×482 side bays + 924 centre bay ≈ 1952 carcass; top/bottom 1984×600 overhang it. Top 1 sits ON the sides/partitions (Rastex dowels in 1, eccentrics in 3/4; step 1.10 «прикрепите крышку с карнизом к собранному корпусу»); cornice 18 (front 2070×86) + 19/20 (sides 643×86) screwed onto the top 1 with 4x25 screws 34 and mitred round the front corners. Sides 3/4 and partitions 5/6 (2040) stand on the bottom 2 (1984×600); plinth box 12/14 (1974×70 front/back) + 13 (522×70 ends) under the bottom 2, joined by Rastex, 12 universal brackets 41 to the carcass, 8 adjustable feet 37. Pilasters 17 (2040×22) on the front edges of the two outer sides. Three bays: side bays 482 wide each with 2 fixed shelves 8/9 (one low, one high) + 2 removable shelves 10 on pins 45 (16 pins = 4 shelves × 4); centre bay 924 wide with 2 fixed shelves 7 (one near the top, one ~1/4 up), rail 38 L=918 on 2 of the 6 rail holders 33 (other 4 optional for 476 rails 48 in the side bays). Царга 11 (924×200) in the centre bay — the leader points to mid-height of the centre/right area; exact position not clear (UNSURE: position of царга 11). Doors: 2 side doors 15 (2036×487) on inset hinges K-16 (47) and 2 centre doors 16 (2036×468) on half-overlay hinges K-9,5 (42) on the partitions — 10+10 hinges → 5 hinges per door. 4 handles 44 (one per door, fixed with 4x25 screws 40). Small iso picture shows the two centre doors as mirrors/glass in a frame and the side doors as framed panels (no mirror part listed). Back ДВП scheme (p2): each side bay 21 (503×430) top + 22 (1222×503, tall) + 21 bottom; centre bay 23 (938×330) top, 24 (938×710) ×2, 23 bottom. No orthographic front view (only an isometric thumbnail on p1).
